name: Venkatagiri sari
subcategory: Geographical Indication craft of Andhra Pradesh
summary: Venkatagiri Saree is a saree style woven in Venkatagiri of Tirupati district in the Indian state of Andhra Pradesh.
description: Venkatagiri Saree is a saree style woven in Venkatagiri of Tirupati district in the Indian state of Andhra Pradesh. It was registered as one of the geographical indication from Andhra Pradesh by Geographical Indications of Goods (Registration and Protection) Act, 1999. Venkatagiri sarees are known for their fine weaving. These style of sarees can also be found in the villages of Sengunthapuram, Variyankaval, Elaiyur, Kallathur, Andimadam and Marudhur villages.
culturalContext: Registered as a Geographical Indication of India (handicraft, Andhra Pradesh; registration 2011–12), which protects the name for products made in its place of origin by traditional methods.
